context: Kenji shows Yuki a transit-info app.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech help; vocabulary (会談/信号/通知/視聴/路線) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: この乗り換えアプリ、便利ですか?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、路線を一目で示してくれます。
lines.en: Yes, it shows the routes at a glance.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 遅れの通知も、来るんですか?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、通知が、すぐに届きます。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 路線図は、信号待ちでも見られますか?
lines.en: Can I view the route map while waiting at a light?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 信号待ちの間に、さっと確認できますよ。
lines.en: You can check quickly while at a signal.
lines.style: reassuring office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ニュースの会談も、視聴できますか?
lines.en: Can I watch the news summit too?
lines.style: engaged office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 会談の中継も、視聴できますよ。
lines.en: You can watch the summit broadcast too.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
